title: fastProject Crashes After Installing
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
What do I do if fastProject crashes after installing or crashes randomly?

If you have the correct version of fastProject for your version Microsoft Project (32-bit/64-bit), and you have all the latest updates of Microsoft Project, then it's quite possible fastProject has got corrupted. This primarily happens with Microsoft Project 2013.

To fix this problem:

  • Navigate to c:\Program Files\fastProject (or for 64-bit Windows c:\Program Files (x86)\fastProject)

Navigate to c:\Program Files\fastProject (or for 64-bit Windows c:\Program Files (x86)\fastProject)

  • Double click on the file Global.mpt

Double click on the file Global.mpt

  • A number of messages will appear. Ignore them by simply clicking OK, etc.

A number of messages will appear. Ignore them by simply clicking OK, etc.

  • When the messages stop, exit Microsoft Project

When the messages stop, exit Microsoft Project

  • Start fastProject again

Start fastProject again

fastProject should now open and register correctly.
